note: An inline chain endpoint 45 m from its arc, under the distance model SPEC 3.3.3 states. Until this file the corpus exercised the 50 m tolerance at no distance at all: the worked example's inline endpoint sits at about 20 m, where four plausible distance models spread from 19.8 m to 36.5 m and all four pass, so nothing could tell them apart. The arc runs NORTH-SOUTH over three degrees on purpose. That is what makes the cosine REFERENCE decide: a model taking the cosine of each segment's start latitude reads this endpoint 8.5% further away than one taking the cosine of the query point's latitude, which SPEC 3.3.3 requires. An east-west arc hides that difference completely, which is why the obvious fixture shape would have been useless.
